Hello, /blog
2026-05-26 · 1 min
#meta

Public log of what I’m learning in security. Writeups, notes, and things that didn’t behave the way I expected.

Why write

The half-life of a half-understood technique is about six weeks. I keep relearning the same stack canaries and format-string offsets, so writing them down forces me past the hand-wave into something I can actually re-derive. Side effect: future me gets a grep-able corpus instead of a tab pile in Notes.app. Anyone else reading is a bonus.

What lives here

  • ctf/ — per-box writeups (HTB, THM, picoCTF). Retired boxes only.
  • notes/ — concept dumps once I can re-derive them.
  • tools/ — scripts I wrote and why.
  • reading/ — paper and book summaries.
  • journal/ — monthly progress, rabbit holes included.

House rules

  • No active vuln details without coordinated disclosure.
  • No client, employer, or coursework material that isn’t explicitly mine to share.
  • One writeup per week beats five then silence.
